title: Azami Chapter 1 current numerical and figure release
description: Frozen processed numerical inputs, current Chapter 1 analysis code, checksum-locked aggregate reference outputs, eight-stage replay receipts, and the checksum/provenance-verified manuscript figure surface for the current GEB-targeted analysis. Numerical reproduction begins from frozen image-derived measurements; original third-party photographs and upstream detector training are outside the minimum numerical replay.

licensing.data_and_third_party_strategy: Keep original Azami software under MIT while preserving source-specific terms and attribution requirements for third-party photographs, CHELSA, Natural Earth, WCVP/POWO, phylogenetic backbones and other externally supplied material; the software license does not relicense third-party data.
